features.claim: It is shaped like a tube with one end bigger than the other.
features.quote: It is shaped like a tube with one end bigger than the other end.

features.claim: It has holes for seven fingers and one thumb.
features.quote: It has holes for seven fingers and one thumb.

features.claim: It has a thumb-hole for the upper hand and holes for seven fingers: three for the upper hand and four for the lower.
features.quote: A recorder can be distinguished from other duct flutes by the presence of a thumb-hole for the upper hand and holes for seven fingers: three for the upper hand and four for the lower.

features.claim: It is traditionally made from wood or ivory.
features.quote: Recorders were traditionally constructed from wood or ivory.

features.claim: Student recorders are commonly made of moulded plastic.
features.quote: student and scholastic recorders are commonly made of moulded plastic
This ability, coupled with its open finger holes, allow it to produce a wide variety of tone colours and special effects.

features.claim: Some recorders have keys to cover tone holes that are too far apart or too large for the fingers.
features.quote: In either case, more ergonomically placed keys can be used to cover the tone holes.

features.claim: A bocal may be used so the player can blow into it while keeping a comfortable hand position.
features.quote: In this case, a bocal may be used to allow the player to blow into the recorder while maintaining a comfortable hand position.

features.claim: Some recorders have a bent bore that brings the windway closer to the keys or finger holes.
features.quote: Alternatively, some recorders have a bent bore that positions the windway closer to the keys or finger holes so the player can comfortably reach both.
